audit.why: Emerald+ 55.24% over 525 games and FAV / 4-10 both fit. Singed owns levels 1-5 because Sejuani has no gap-closer until Arctic Assault and no way to stop a run-past, level 6 flips to her on Glacial Prison, first item is even, and two items goes back to Singed. Packet chart, both layers and the Sejuani-side audit in audits/top/sejuani__singed.json all agree, so no side or rating moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spikes are correctly placed but numberless — 'respect her ult range' with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Glacial Prison is 120/105/90s and Arctic Assault is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s. Those two numbers are what make level 6 survivable: her ult is a two-minute cooldown at rank 1, so one dodged bola buys you a full wave cycle of free proxying.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[4].why and whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions are missing and the page tracks the wrong ability. Permafrost is named matchup-defining in focus, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and report[5] — it is a 1.5s-cooldown finisher that only fires on a target already at max Frost stacks, so there is nothing to bait. Meanwhile Mega Adhesive's grounding is never mentioned, and Frost Armor's slow immunity is never mentioned.
audit.why: Two facts from Riot's own text. First, Mega Adhesive 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it' and Arctic Assault is Sejuani's only dash — standing in the goo she cannot charge in and cannot charge out, which is the whole reason she loses the chase. Second, Fury of the North: 'After being out of combat, Sejuani gains Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows. Frost Armor persists for a short time after Sejuani takes damage.' Singed's entire pressure is slow-based — Mega Adhesive and Rylai's — and none of it lands on a Sejuani who has not been in combat. Poison Trail is the tag that starts stripping it. The cooldowns that actually gate her are Arctic Assault at 18s rank 1 and Winter's Wrath at 9s (the Frost applier), not Permafrost.
audit.corrected: focus retargeted to Arctic Assault, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], report[5], dontsFull[0].d and content wants.you[1] rewritten around grounding and Frost Armor.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns points at Permafrost, a 1.5-second ability.
audit.why: There is no window to open on a 1.5s cooldown. Arctic Assault at 18s rank 1 is her commit, and Glacial Prison at 120s rank 1 is the one that decides whether level 6 is safe.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Sejuani 'him' and 'he' in five places while the content layer correctly uses 'she'. The two layers render on the same page.
audit.why: Sejuani is female. A reader who sees both layers reads it as machine-generated and stops trusting the rest.
audit.corrected: tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and phases[4].why fixed.
